pointer_keys.definition: for each mention_span_bos, indices from mention start through next token id 18 (period), exclusive of decision_position_bos

objective.answer_ce: teacher-forced CE on correct candidate_token_ids + EOS only (not prompt)

corpus: T3 rebuilt train/DEV/ACQ16; T3 TEST never loaded; independent-item QA batches; same mix as T17 (no template reweight)
study_rule: HARD_STOP if any; >=2 FULL_SUCCESS => FULL_SUCCESS; >=2 of FULL or REPRESENTATION_SUCCESS_OUTPUT_FAIL => REPRESENTATION_SUCCESS_OUTPUT_FAIL; >=2 LANGUAGE_REGRESSION; >=2 SHORTCUT; else FAIL_NO_REPRESENTATION. Do not lower the 2/3 bar.
